### Q.1
`Q.1 Add code in line no. 4, 9 and 12 i.e. dotted lines such that the function reverses the linked list.`
`                     [CO 1 (Understanding), 3 Marks]`

```text
Node * reverseList (LinkedList * l)
1. {
2. Node * a=l->head;
3. Node *b = l->head->next;
4. while(---------)
5. { Node * c=b->next;
6. b->next=a;
7. a=b;
8. b=c;
9. ........... }
10. b->next=a;
11. l->head->next=NULL;
12. ---------;
13. return l->head;
14. }
```
*(Note: In the exam paper, lines 1–7 are printed in the left column and lines 8–14 in the right column to save space, but they form a single sequential function as shown above.)*

`a) enQ(int * Q, int size, int info) that add integer info at the rear index of the array Q implemented as a Queue.`
`b) int deQ(int * Q, int size) which delete the element from the front index and return it.`
